title: OSF payload envelope (NATS, MQTT, Kafka) - v1.0.0
description: GENERATED from standard/sync/uns-convention.json 1.2.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Two shapes. signal = OT world (categories machine): one message per signal; telemetry on factory.{site}.{machine}.telemetry.{attr}, transactional on factory.{site}.{machine}.event.{attr} (stream FACTORY). entity = IT world (categories business, material, quality, equipment): one message per source row on business.{enterprise}.{sourceId}.{entity}.{eventType}.{id} (stream BUSINESS), always transactional. A transactional message carries msgId: the JetStream Nats-Msg-Id and the Kafka key, for deduplication.

element_id.description: Machine key (contract nodes.Machine.key); a subject token.

attr.description: Attribute name of the machine profile.

value.description: The value, typed by the attribute (x-signals of the profile payload).

delivery.description: The delivery class of the attribute (profile `delivery`); it decides the subject.

msgId.description: Unique message id (Nats-Msg-Id / Kafka key). Required for transactional.

quality.description: OPC UA StatusCode of the reading (Good, Uncertain, Bad...).

unit.description: UNECE Rec. 20 code of the attribute.

id.description: The row key = the kgIdProperty value of the profile; a subject token.

data.description: The attributes of the profile, typed per profile.
